body.name: Fixed \(r=2\) Conflict Graph Design
body.construction: Apply Algorithm 1 of \cite{KandirosPipisDaskalakisHarshaw2024CGD} with \(r=2\), formal direct-effect conflict graph \(\mathcal H_n\), rank map \(\pi_n\), and coordinates \(U_{n,i}\) to obtain \(Z_n\); the strict earlier-neighbor sets are \(B_{n,i}\) from \(G_n\). On \(E_{n,i,1}\) the algorithm realizes \(\mathbf e_{n,i}\) in unit \(i\)'s closed \(G_n\)-neighborhood, and on \(E_{n,i,0}\) it realizes \(\mathbf 0_n\) there.
